footer: Source: SEC EDGAR XBRL data (10-K filed 2025-02-14): the full fiscal year as reported. Percentages show each item’s share of the node it splits from or flows into. n/m = not meaningful (a comparison period was ≤ 0 or changed sign).

Working capital & other is the residual between operating cash flow and the listed items. Free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures (gross purchases of property and equipment); a company’s own (adjusted) free cash flow may net asset sales or incentives and differ.
GAAP: the statement lines as reported. Derived here, not line items in the filing: other income or expense (net), working capital & other, free cash flow and the Δ scale/mix figures.

nodes.name: Seed
nodes.source: A revenue line: revenue tagged ctva:SeedMember on StatementBusinessSegmentsAxis in the filing’s own XBRL (the lines add up to total revenue).

nodes.name: Crop Protection
nodes.source: A revenue line: revenue tagged ctva:CropProtectionMember on StatementBusinessSegmentsAxis in the filing’s own XBRL (the lines add up to total revenue).

nodes.name: Revenue
nodes.source: Reported line: “Revenues” (us-gaap:Revenues), from SEC’s XBRL company facts. Total revenues (us-gaap:Revenues) when the company tags them; otherwise, when it tags revenue more than one way, the largest.

nodes.name: Operating profit
nodes.source: The filing has no operating income line, so operating profit is shown equal to pre-tax earnings.

nodes.name: Costs & expenses
nodes.source: Calculated: revenue − operating profit (all costs and expenses together).

nodes.name: Pre-tax earnings
nodes.source: Reported line: “Income (Loss) from Continuing Operations before Income Taxes, Noncontrolling Interest” (us-gaap:IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxesExtraordinaryItemsNoncontrollingInterest), from SEC’s XBRL company facts.

nodes.name: Cost of revenue
nodes.source: Reported line: “Cost of Goods and Services Sold” (us-gaap:CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold), from SEC’s XBRL company facts.

nodes.name: Research & development
nodes.source: Reported line: “Research and Development Expense” (us-gaap:ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense), from SEC’s XBRL company facts.

nodes.name: SG&A
nodes.source: Reported line: “Selling, General and Administrative Expense” (us-gaap:SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpense), from SEC’s XBRL company facts.

nodes.name: Other operating costs
nodes.source: Calculated: operating costs − the cost lines shown separately (what the filing does not itemize).

nodes.name: Net earnings
nodes.source: Reported line: “Net Income (Loss), Including Portion Attributable to Noncontrolling Interest” (us-gaap:ProfitLoss), from SEC’s XBRL company facts.

nodes.name: Income tax
nodes.source: Reported line: “Income Tax Expense (Benefit)” (us-gaap:IncomeTaxExpenseBenefit), from SEC’s XBRL company facts.

nodes.name: Depreciation & amortization
nodes.source: Reported line: “Depreciation, Depletion and Amortization” (us-gaap:DepreciationDepletionAndAmortization), from SEC’s XBRL company facts.

nodes.name: Working capital & other
nodes.source: Calculated: operating cash flow − net earnings − depreciation & amortization − share-based compensation (the residual: working capital and other items).

nodes.name: Operating cash flow
nodes.source: Reported line: “Net Cash Provided by (Used in) Operating Activities” (us-gaap:NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities), from SEC’s XBRL company facts.

nodes.name: Free cash flow (OCF − capex)
nodes.source: Calculated: operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Proceeds from selling assets and finance-lease repayments are not netted, so it can differ from a free cash flow figure the company reports itself.

nodes.name: Capital expenditures
nodes.source: Reported line: “Capital expenditures” (us-gaap:PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets), from SEC’s XBRL company facts.

fcf_note.line: company figure: read for quarters only

check.text: Company-reported free cash flow is read for quarters only, so free cash flow is calculated: operating cash flow − capital expenditures ($1.5B).

fcf_note.footer: No company-reported free cash flow (read for quarters only): free cash flow here is calculated by the formula.

checks.text: Pre-tax earnings minus tax did not equal net earnings in the filing (often discontinued operations or equity-method income); pre-tax is shown as net earnings plus tax.
The filing has no operating income figure: operating profit is shown equal to pre-tax earnings.

analysis: Revenue was $16.9B in FY2024, down 2% year over year. Seed was the largest line at 56% of revenue. Crop Protection lost $0.39B year over year (down 5%), 123% of the total change.
Operating profit was $1.3B, a 7.9% margin (up 2.7 points year over year). Total costs fell 5% while revenue fell 2%. Net earnings were $0.91B, up 23% year over year. The effective tax rate was 31.0%.

Operating cash flow was $2.1B (up 21% year over year), 233% of net earnings. Non-cash charges added back $1.2B of depreciation and amortization. Capital expenditures of $0.60B left free cash flow of $1.5B.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Short-term investments
lines.why: Securities held for the cash they will return: financial.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Inventory
lines.why: Goods held for sale: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Equity-method investments
lines.why: Stakes in associated businesses, usually part of operations. Financial if held as an investment.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.why: Other long-term operating items: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Income taxes payable
lines.why: Taxes on operating income: operating.

lines.name: Short-term debt and commercial paper
lines.why: Borrowed money: financial.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Pension and retiree benefits
lines.why: Promised to employees for their work: operating (some analysts treat the unfunded part as debt).

lines.name: Deferred revenue, non-current
lines.why: Customers' payments for later years: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.
